---
title: "App-owned security headers and edge overrides"
description: "Per-host framing intent versus observed headers, and the gated end state for Managed Transform security headers."
---

The end state is **application-owned response security headers**, with Cloudflare
Managed Transform **Add security headers OFF only after every affected app is
proven**. This is future work, not today's change. Finance's temporary scoped
Transform Rule and its rollback remain exclusively with the Finance cutover owner.
This amendment changes no Cloudflare setting or response rule.

## Current read-only evidence

At **26 October 2026, 15:55:32 GMT+7**, the Managed Transforms GET returned
`add_security_headers.enabled=true`. One public `HEAD /` on each of the eight
currently proxied hosts returned `X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN`. The transform's
[documented security-header behavior](https://developers.cloudflare.com/rules/transform/managed-transforms/reference/#add-security-headers)
includes this value. Finance's owner separately reports that this overrides its
Worker's DENY/default and exact WebGL pass-through policy.

`inventory/r3-live.json` retains only sanitized status, XFO, CSP frame-ancestors,
redirect host/path and timestamps. No redirects were followed. No response body,
cookie, full CSP, nonce, query secret, authenticated page or iframe was collected.
A root redirect/error does not prove the final page's policy or an embed failure.
No transform was toggled to establish causality in this lane.

## Preserve exact embedding and CSP boundaries

Finance's allowed WebGL subtree is
`^/api/v1/workspaces/[^/]+/external-projects/assets/[^/]+/webgl(?:/|$)` at its
pinned `packages/utils/src/framable-paths.ts:20`. A complete WebGL segment is
required. Near misses such as `webgl-extra`, `webglx` and `webgl;params` must not
inherit the exception. Encoded-path behavior remains a normalization acceptance
case. Do not replace exact matching with a substring.

The uploaded-WebGL handler's CSP is
`sandbox allow-scripts allow-downloads allow-pointer-lock allow-modals`
(`apps/web/src/legacy-api-routes/v1/workspaces/[wsId]/external-projects/assets/[assetId]/webgl/[...assetPath]/route.ts:22`,
`:468`). Preserve that sandbox and all other upstream CSP directives. Allowing
framing while dropping sandbox changes the trust boundary. XFO has no permissive
wildcard: this exception needs XFO absence, not SAMEORIGIN. Auth/error responses
may deliberately carry stricter CSP and must not be weakened by the exception.

Do not infer that SAMEORIGIN overrides CSP frame-ancestors in browsers. Record
both independent headers and execute the intended browser embedding case; the
observed XFO difference alone does not prove every route is exploitable or broken.

## Gated end-state sequence and rollback

1. **Keep today's zone state unchanged in this lane.** Finance's owner can apply
   its separately authorized narrow correction and record exact host/path,
   rule ID/position, before/after headers and rollback. Do not broaden it into a
   satellite-wide header policy or copy its secret-bearing configuration.
2. Assign an app/service/storage owner to every affected host. Install or prove
   app-owned policy in the **actual publisher/runtime**, including native Meet,
   Colab direct assets, service errors and R2 inline/download behavior. Inventory
   every header supplied by Add security headers, not only XFO, and preserve
   required nosniff/referrer policies. Unknown ownership holds global removal.
3. Run exact-source header regression coverage, then an owner-admitted hosted
   matrix: ordinary pages, redirects, errors, static assets, auth/API responses,
   exact allowed embed paths, near misses and socket101. Compare intended policy,
   controlled pre-transform origin evidence and final proxied headers separately.
   Prove sandbox/CSP preservation and actual framing in a browser where applicable.
4. Once **every affected proxied host** has accepted app-owned coverage, re-read
   the current host list, Managed Transform and all scoped overrides. Capture the
   zone owner's approval, IDs/order, source/deployment identities and rollback.
   Only then separately authorize Add security headers OFF. New hosts require
   their own acceptance before joining the completed set.
5. Recheck the complete final-edge matrix and browser outcomes after that future
   change. Remove redundant scoped exceptions only through their owners after
   proving they no longer supply required policy. If any unexplained policy is
   lost, restore the captured transform/override state under the zone owner and
   stop expansion; do not accept global weakening because one embed works.

`policy.framingHeaders` and the validator require per-app/per-host evidence and
rollback before this end state. The readiness remains incomplete today: no global
transform was changed, no app header fix was shipped by this amendment, and no
iframe/browser acceptance was executed. The source/config and live-header matrix
are evidence for the next admitted per-app work, not approval to turn it off.


The Meet, Colab, Lettin and Parley rows each record the Managed Transform's
`SAMEORIGIN` override against that satellite's source intent. These observations
remain root-response evidence only. Hive's current maintenance Worker identity
and URL flags were separately verified at 16:37 GMT+7; its historical socket
source is not a live path claim. No Managed Transform setting changed.
